opennyai_summary.21_June_2023__arguments:
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered under Sections 498A, 341, 323, 504,
506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Allegation against the petitioner is of committing torture upon the victim due to non-fulfilment of demand of dowry.
The petitioner has relied upon the Saurabh Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169297507/
1 judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs.
The State of Bihar, reported in 2006(3) PLJR 182.
On behalf of the State and learned counsel for the opposite party No.2
opennyai_summary.facts:
On the earlier occasion, four criminal cases have been instituted for similar offence against the petitioner and his family members.
, it is submitted that the petitioner is named in the complaint case/F.I.R.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances
opennyai_summary.21_June_2023__decision:
, let the petitioner, above named, in the event of arrest/surrender before the learned court below within a period of twelve weeks from today, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below/concerned Court in connection with Complaint case No.1561(C)/2020, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
The petitioner is directed to co-operate during the trial.
If the petitioner does not co
- operate during the trial, the court below will be at liberty to cancel the bail bonds of the petitioner.
If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.27824 of 2023(2) dt.21-06-2023 make an application before the Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Centre for the purpose of reconciliation or one time settlement.
In case, any such application is made by either of the parties, the court below shall refer the matter to the District Mediation Centre.
